title: Place and configure stepper reference components
text: Use existing schematic_place_symbol with symbolId stepper_28byj48_12v, stepper_17hs19_2004s1, stepper_23hs30_2804s, driver_uln2003, driver_tmc2209 or driver_dm542t_v4. Inspect tool schemas and schematic_get_parameters; edit with schematic_set_parameters and wire using schematic_connect. These are reference_model parts. NEMA models default to an explicitly approximate holding-torque sinusoidal calibration; Kt/Ke are not measured specifications. The unidentified 12V 28BYJ requires user winding R/L, rotor inertia, electrical cycles and Kt/Ke before simulation. Four unipolar phases use COM/A/B/C/D and ULN low-side outputs; bipolar windings use A+/A-/B+/B-. Drivers are functional port references, not exact carrier pinouts. TMC/DM execute averaged current limiting and STEP/DIR/disable, not actual PWM/UART/thermal behavior; set peak rather than RMS current. DM reference assumes S2=5V, so 3.3V does not assert high. Time steps must resolve all pulse transitions. Configure external load inertia/damping/torque on the motor; separate ideal gearbox telemetry is not a mechanical connection port. Save/reopen uses ordinary diagram persistence. See docs/STEPPER_MOTOR_LIBRARY.md and assets/stepper-motor-reference.json for limits and provenance.
